newsitem.title: UK: Canadian Air in pact with Thai forwarder.
newsitem.headline: Canadian Air in pact with Thai forwarder.

text.p: Canadian Airlines Corp's cargo division has formed a C$12 million partnership with Thailand-based Commercial Transport International Co Ltd (CTI).
CTI is ranked among the top 10 revenue-earning international airfreight forwarders in Canada, Canadian Air said in a statement received here..
"This partnership...emphasises our commitment to serving the Asian marketplace," said Canadian AirCargo vice-president Barry Rempel in the statement.
In the Asia-Pacific region, Canadian serves Tokyo, Manila, Bangkok and Kuala Lumpur from Vancouver. - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel +44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
